verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a dedicated CAPTCHA page stating that it detects CAPTCHAs with its vision model and solves them automatically. It names the supported types: reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, FunCaptcha/ArkoseLabs, MTCaptcha, and image CAPTCHAs. That is a clear, documented stance, but the docs never say what happens when solving fails, so the 'no silent failures' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented behavior when a CAPTCHA can't be solved (a captcha-specific failure category or escalation), human handoff explicitly tied to CAPTCHAs (the VNC take-control feature is documented only as general session control), and independent or hands-on corroboration of solve reliability.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can rely on a documented captcha stance — automatic solving, human fallback, or explicit non-support — instead of silent task failures
